This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/trust-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/trust-ai-performance-metric-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
accuracy AccuracyThe proportion of evaluated cases for which the AI system produced the correct result.
sensitivity SensitivityThe proportion of relevant positive cases correctly identified by the AI system.
specificity SpecificityThe proportion of relevant negative cases correctly identified by the AI system.
robustness RobustnessThe ability of the AI system to maintain appropriate performance under variations, disturbances, or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use.
